meta.title: Prism Vault
doc.title: Prism Vault · Stack, blast, discover
doc.description: Link colors, set off chain blasts, and hunt for hidden relics in a candlelit workshop and a moonlit greenhouse. After three treasure hunts, the run carries on as an endless score chase.
intro.title: Every drop finds something.
intro.lede: Link colors, trigger chains. Finish three treasure hunts, then chase an endless high score.

hunt.workshopCopy: Find the 5 relics on the list. They hide on shelves, sills and in corners the candle can't reach.
hunt.greenhouseCopy: 7 fireflies hide among the leaves, seed trays and glass frames. Watch for a soft blink.
